items.title: 5.3 Enzyme ke kaam ka tareeqa (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.3, printed pages 129-131.

blocks.text: Kisi chemical reaction ki raftar is baat par munhasir hai ke use shuru karne ke liye kitni activation energy chahiye. Activation energy woh tawanai hai jo pehle se maujood chemical bonds ko kamzor (destabilize) karti hai. Enzymes reactants ko sahi rukh (correct orientation) mein qareeb laate hain, ya reactants ke khaas bonds par dabao (stress) dalte hain. Is tarah naye bonds banne ke liye zaroori activation energy kam ho jati hai aur reaction ki raftar barh jati hai (Figure 5.2). Reactions apni aam raftar se kahin zyada tez chalte hain.

blocks.alt: Tawanai (energy) aur reaction ke waqt (reaction time) ka graph. Dono curves reactants ki satah se shuru ho kar neeche products ki satah par khatam hote hain. Surkh curve (bina enzyme) oonchi choti tak jata hai; neela curve (enzyme ke saath) kahin neechi choti tak. Har choti se nuqtedar lakeer hai, aur reactants ki satah se chotiyon tak do-rukhe teer High (Ea) aur Low (Ea) likhe hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Reaction shuru hone ke liye reactants ko tawanai ki ek pahari charhni parti hai; yahi activation energy (Ea) hai. Surkh pahari (bina enzyme) oonchi hai, is liye Ea zyada (High). Neeli pahari (enzyme ke saath) neechi hai, is liye Ea kam (Low) aur reaction tez chalta hai. Dono curves ek hi reactants se shuru aur ek hi products par khatam hote hain: enzyme products ko nahin badalta.

Enzyme ki maujoodgi aakhri products (end products) ki fitrat ya khususiyat ko nahin badalti. Maslan sucrose (substrate) hamesha glucose aur fructose (products) mein hi tootega, chahe sucrase (enzyme) maujood ho ya na ho; enzyme sirf kaam ko tez karta hai.

Apni khaas pehchan (specificity) ki wajah se enzyme ek khaas substrate ko pehchanta hai. Substrate enzyme ke active site se jurta hai. Is tarah enzyme-substrate complex (ES complex) banta hai aur catalytic site active ho jata hai. Catalytic site ke atoms substrate ke khaas bonds par dabao dal kar unhein kamzor karte hain, is liye activation energy kam ho jati hai. Isi se reaction shuru hota hai aur substrate products mein badal jata hai. Is ke baad enzyme products se alag ho jata hai aur bilkul waisa hi rehta hai jaisa pehle tha. Enzyme ke kaam ka tareeqa mukhtasar taur par yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: E (Enzyme) + S (Substrate) → ES (Enzyme-substrate complex) → E (Enzyme) + P (Product)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Enzyme (E) aur substrate (S) mil kar ES complex banate hain; phir products (P) bante hain aur enzyme (E) bina badle wapas mil jata hai. Is liye enzyme bar bar istemal ho sakta hai.

Respiration, photosynthesis aur protein synthesis jaise pecheeda (complex) metabolic raston (pathways) mein bohat se enzymes ek tarteeb (sequence) se kaam karte hain aur raste ke har qadam ko control karte hain. Yeh aage peeche wale enzymes apne cofactors ke saath ek hi jagah maujood hote hain. Ek enzyme ke products agle qadam ke enzyme ke liye substrate bante hain aur agle products mein badalte hain. Yeh silsila chalta rehta hai aur aakhir mein end products bante hain jo feedback ke zariye pehle enzyme ko rok (inhibit) dete hain.
Enzymes ke kaam ke tareeqe ke models

1894 mein German chemist Emil Fischer ne lock-and-key model pesh kiya. Is model ke mutabiq “jaise ek khaas chaabi (key) sirf ek khaas taala (lock) khol sakti hai, isi tarah ek khaas enzyme sirf ek khaas substrate ko products mein badal sakta hai”. Yeh model kehta hai ke active site ek sakht (rigid) banawat hai, aur enzyme ke kaam se pehle, dauran ya baad us mein koi tabdeeli ya lachak (flexibility) nahin hoti (Figure 5.3).

blocks.alt: Teer se jure chaar marhale ek qatar mein. Enzyme ka block jis ka active site bilkul substrate ki dandi ki shakal ka kata hua hai, aur upar substrate; substrate neeche aa kar fit hota hai aur active site mein koi tabdeeli nahin hoti; substrate site mein betha hua, enzyme-substrate complex; enzyme bina badle, do products alag hote hue. Labels: Substrate, Active site, Enzyme, No change occurs at active site, Enzyme-substrate complex, Products.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3: Enzyme ke kaam ka lock-and-key model (kitab ki Figure 5.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is model mein active site sakht (rigid) hai: us ki shakal pehle se substrate ke bilkul mutabiq hai, jaise tala aur chabi. Is liye doosre marhale mein likha hai ke active site mein koi tabdeeli nahin hoti. Substrate fit ho kar complex banata hai, products bante hain, aur enzyme apni usi shakal mein dobara kaam ke liye tayyar rehta hai.

Baad ki tehqeeq (later studies) ne har reaction mein lock-and-key model ki tasdeeq nahin ki. Naye saboot (evidence) ki bunyad par American biochemist Daniel Koshland ne 1958 mein induced fit model pesh kiya. Is model ke mutabiq “jab substrate enzyme ke binding site se jurta hai to woh enzyme ki banawat mein tabdeeliyan paida (induce) karta hai. In tabdeeliyon se enzyme apna catalytic kaam zyada behtar tareeqe se kar pata hai.” Yeh model kehta hai ke active site sakht nahin hai; enzyme ka kaam (catalysis) shuru hone se pehle us mein tabdeeli aur lachak aa sakti hai (Figure 5.4).

blocks.alt: Teer se jure chaar marhale ek qatar mein. Gol enzyme jis ka active site tang darar (slit) jaisa hai aur upar cone jaisa substrate; substrate andar aate hue darar ko chaura karta hai (enzyme ki banawat mein tabdeeli); substrate nai shakal ke shigaf mein poora fit hai (enzyme-substrate complex); products, ek gend aur ek cone, alag hote hain aur darar phir tang ho jati hai (enzyme apni asal banawat wapas pa leta hai).
blocks.caption: Figure 5.4: Enzyme ke kaam ka induced-fit model (kitab ki Figure 5.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Teer se jure chaar marhale ek qatar mein. Labels: Substrate, Active site, Enzyme, Changes induced in enzyme structure, Enzyme-substrate complex, Enzyme regains its original structure, Products.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yahan active site shuru mein substrate ki shakal ka nahin, sirf ek tang darar hai. Substrate jab binding site se milta hai to enzyme ki banawat badalti (induce hoti) hai aur site substrate ke gird theek beth jati hai. Kaam ke baad enzyme phir apni pehli shakal mein aa jata hai. Lock-and-key se farq yahi hai: wahan site sakht hai, yahan lachakdar (flexible).

blocks.caption: Lock-and-key ka induced fit se muqabla
rows: Sakht; kaam se pehle, dauran ya baad koi tabdeeli nahin
Lachakdar; substrate jurne par shakal badalta hai
Substrate site se bilkul milta hai, jaise tale mein chabi
Jurna site ko substrate ke gird dhalne par uksata hai
Makhsoos-pan samjhata hai; tamam reactions mein himayat nahin
Baad ke shawahid par mabni; zyada moassar catalysis samjhata hai

blocks.prompt: Sucrase sucrose ko glucose aur fructose mein torta hai. Batayen ke enzyme kya badalta hai aur kya nahin, aur samjhayen ke induced fit model lock-and-key se behtar kaise hai.
blocks.explanation: Enzyme activation energy kam karta hai aur yun reaction tez karta hai; yeh products (sucrose se phir bhi glucose aur fructose) ya khud ko nahin badalta. Lock-and-key active site ko sakht manta hai; induced fit kehta hai ke substrate ka jurna enzyme ki shakal badalta hai taake woh substrate ko pakre aur zyada moassar catalyse kare, jis ki baad ke shawahid himayat karte hain.

items: Activation energy maujooda bonds ko kamzor karti hai; enzymes reactants ko sahi rukh de kar ya un ke bonds par dabao dal kar ise kam karte hain, to reactions tez chalte hain aur products wahi rehte hain.
Tareeqa: E + S → ES complex → E + P; enzyme bina badle alag hota hai. Raston mein enzymes tarteeb se kaam karte hain aur end products feedback se pehle enzyme ko rokte hain.
Lock-and-key (Fischer, 1894): sakht active site, ek khaas substrate. Induced fit (Koshland, 1958): substrate jurne par active site ki shakal badalti hai aur catalysis behtar hota hai.
